newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SBS6 raises share of Dutch TV audience in January.
newsitem.headline: SBS6 raises share of Dutch TV audience in January.

text.p: Market leader RTL4 saw its share of the Dutch television audience decline two percentage points in January to 22 percent. SBS6 saw its market share rise by the same margin to nine percent.
The NOS audience research unit published the following Dutch television viewing figures for January:
Channel Audience share in pct: Jan 97 Dec 96 Jan 96
NOTES - NL1, NL2 and NL3 are public channels. RTL4, RTL5, Veronica and SBS6 are commercial channels.
RTL4 and RTL5 -- Dutch publisher VNU owns 38 pct of both channels, Luxembourg-based CLT owns 61 pct of both.
SBS6 -- Scandinavian Broadcasting System owns 70 pct of SBS6, Dutch publisher De Telegraaf 30 percent.
Veronica -- Left the public broadcasting system in 1995 to become a commercial station.
Other channels -- these are foreign channels and various small Dutch channels.
